title: Pre-expansion consistency and health baseline
summary: Closed automatically after all stored run-contract slices were completed or skipped.

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 26-slice health rationale, order, LLM benchmark, preservation boundary, verification policy, and stop conditions.

allowedWork: Audit and enforce canonical extension paths, ownership, public seams, runtime authorities, compatibility evidence, and impact verification.
Repair catalogue equation and graph stage reservation while preserving visible choreography and existing thresholds.
Migrate legacy equation presentation metadata to existing typed profiles and delete only proven last-caller compatibility.
Add bounded health commands, negative fixtures, release evidence, and fresh LLM generation benchmarks.
disallowedWork: Do not modify user-owned economics source or generated publication, or unrelated untracked documents.

No layout pruning quota, visual redesign, TypeScript or Python exemplar, matrix or curriculum expansion, Graph3D promotion, SvelteKit migration, public projection choice, universal scene graph, package reorganization, repository-wide deep-import rewrite, or full timeline unification.
goal: Reduce KP's effective decision surface, repair known health defects, align standards with executable APIs, and prove whether established animation vocabulary is materially easier for a fresh LLM to compose.
commitCadence: Commit each independently reversible verified slice with completed Theseus evidence; never stage user-owned economics files or unrelated documents.
stopConditions: Stop for an unexplained semantic or visual regression, loss of static or accessibility behavior, invalid provenance, unsafe persistence, threshold relaxation, or a second runtime authority.
Stop at a human checkpoint if the catalogue repair requires subjective visual judgment or changes approved choreography.
Stop if compatibility cannot be retired without an unplanned migration, bundle growth is unbounded, protected user files overlap, or work expands beyond the approved scope.

slices.title: Capture pre-expansion baseline
slices.summary: Captured revision, source/test scale, public seams, classified compatibility, build size, architecture status, exact equation and graph CLS failures, ResizeObserver symptom, and protected dirty-file hashes in an immutable baseline.

slices.title: Classify regression families
slices.summary: Classified five evidence-backed regression families: representation substitution, semantic-identity substitution, late visual proof, lifecycle/reservation churn, and timing-policy leakage; assigned each to typed, architecture, browser, or human gates.

slices.title: Audit canonical extension path
slices.summary: Audited the end-to-end extension chain and found one concrete guidance conflict: the released governed canonical-construction public API is the new-work authority, while llm-animation-draft v2 is retained compatibility evidence. Classified adjacent internal, renderer, host, Article, and metadata paths.

slices.title: Reconcile current instructions
slices.summary: Reconciled current LLM entrypoint, asset authoring spec, and system vocabulary with the released governed canonical-construction public API; explicitly demoted llm-animation-draft v2 to compatibility/research and added an executable guidance regression.

slices.title: Inventory public APIs and deep imports
slices.summary: Classified 13 named public modules by authority, added the omitted governed construction facade to the executable 19-surface caller ledger, and rejected raw deep-import counts as a repository-wide migration metric in favor of cross-owner ratchets.

slices.title: Inventory runtime authorities
slices.summary: Added an executable 12-entry runtime authority inventory distinguishing pure sampling, playhead ownership, frame delivery, capability caches, adapter registries, presentation caches, and host lifecycles; classified four compatibility-managed owners and preserved the dashboard-only legacy exception outside runtime.

slices.title: Strengthen compatibility evidence
slices.summary: Required every active compatibility entry to carry live consumers, replacement source evidence, executable sunset tests, closure requirements, and an explicit retirement condition; the architecture gate now validates replacement references.

slices.title: Attribute catalogue layout shifts
slices.summary: Attributed the stable-reservation CLS failures to late KaTeX family and catalogue reading-font metrics plus a narrow dev-toolbar stylesheet ordering shift; enhanced failure evidence with source nodes and rectangles.

slices.title: Repair equation-stage reservation
slices.summary: Equation and catalogue reading fonts now settle at the lazy capability boundary before first visible stage mount; solve-x passes the unchanged 0.001 CLS ceiling with stable outer geometry.

slices.title: Repair graph-stage reservation if shared
slices.summary: Graph SVG shares the KaTeX font-reservation cause; the same capability helper plus corrected dev-toolbar stylesheet ordering closes narrow-route CLS without graph-specific geometry or appearance changes.

slices.title: Verify capability and performance closure
slices.summary: Closed the repair with 5/5 browser capability checks, the unchanged CLS ceiling, typecheck, 15 focused route/capability/preparation tests, architecture, and bundle gates; measured catalogue-route script is 111425 gzip bytes against 190000.

slices.title: Migrate linear solve typed profile
slices.summary: Migrated canonical and teacher-detail linear solve assets from recipe metadata to typed equation presentation profiles; exact semantic serialization, direct seek, rewind, source lineage, focused tests, architecture, and typecheck pass.

slices.title: Forbid new legacy recipe authoring
slices.summary: All 25 concrete equation-target catalogue assets now author typed profiles, including generated drafts, generated problems, comparisons, complex KaTeX samples, and inequality; a catalogue ratchet proves zero legacy metadata authors. Focused tests, typecheck, and architecture pass.

slices.title: Prove legacy decoder reachability
slices.summary: Proved the legacy decoder has no public export, serialized ingress, production author, or concrete catalogue dependency; all 25 equation-target assets carry typed profiles. Durable audit selects explicit stale-input failure and bounded retirement.

slices.title: Retire proven legacy recipe paths
slices.summary: Deleted the 466-line legacy profile decoder and 200-line decoder suite, removed nine obsolete metadata compatibility paths plus the metadata authoring helper, and added explicit stale-key validation. The 251-test convergence suite, typecheck, and architecture gates pass.

slices.title: Move presentation profile ownership
slices.summary: Moved the equation presentation policy and branch-strategy reader into src/animation, updated every production/test caller, marked the compiler stage canonical, removed the ownership-debt entry, and updated the roadmap. No renderer resources entered the neutral owner.

slices.title: Resolve sampled payload ownership debt
slices.summary: Separated canonical closed sampled payloads from the older public SDK EquationMotionFrame: the former are already neutral and canonical; the latter remains renderer-owned because a file-only move would reverse dependencies. Removed false debt and documented the justified retention; 36 focused tests, typecheck, and architecture pass.

slices.title: Ratchet touched public seams
slices.summary: Added the neutral equation presentation policy to the executable caller ledger with an exact 13-caller source set, no renderer imports, and tombstones for the old renderer policy and decoder paths. Focused seam tests, typecheck, and architecture pass.

slices.title: Standardize equivalent capability packs
slices.summary: Made all catalog packs data-only; moved exact quantity, operation evaluation, and place value surface registration behind explicit injected lazy capabilities; added all-pack import-side-effect ratchet. Focused tests, typecheck, architecture, and bundle boundary pass.

slices.title: Standardize typed failure boundaries
slices.summary: Added typed catalog-load, selected-capability, and selection-preparation failures; failed pack/capability promises are retryable; selection preparation remains atomic; both catalogue hosts retain the last valid stage while loading and on failed replacement. 26 focused tests, typecheck, architecture, and diff checks pass.

slices.title: Expand impact verification mapping
slices.summary: Added dedicated impact gates for equation presentation policy, lazy catalogue capability boundaries, stable stage reservation, animation ownership seams, and compiled Article publication paths. Sixteen selector/CLI tests and four representative CLI selections pass with no unmatched path.

slices.title: Consolidate redundant touched tests
slices.summary: Removed one redundant fixture-level legacy-key assertion now subsumed by the all-25-assets/all-nine-keys authoring ratchet, documented why semantic, architecture, browser, responsive, accessibility, and bundle proofs remain distinct, and retained the earlier decoder-suite deletion. Twenty-five touched tests and diff checks pass.

slices.title: Add negative health fixtures
slices.summary: Added executable architecture validators and one synthetic negative fixture suite rejecting a duplicate scoped clock, catalog-pack editor import/import-time registration, legacy recipe metadata, unclassified compatibility, and a neutral-to-renderer import. The architecture gate now runs the reusable validators; negative test, typecheck, and architecture pass.

slices.title: Add pre-expansion health commands
slices.summary: Added stable health:pre-expansion and health:pre-expansion:release commands. The focused command composes architecture, types, 252 convergence tests, 37 catalogue tests, negative fixtures, bundle ceilings, and publication parity; the release variant adds browser capability proof, full tests, production build, and Theseus validation. Focused health passes.

slices.title: Run complete release matrix
slices.summary: Complete release matrix passes without relaxed thresholds: focused health gates, 5/5 browser capability and CLS checks, 4,147/4,147 tests, zero Svelte diagnostics, production build, and Theseus validation of 937 nodes. Three stale test expectations were repaired to reflect the new architecture: explicit capability loading, migrated animated profiles, and the new health-ledger caller.

slices.title: Benchmark LLM generation and close out
slices.summary: Three fresh read-only bounded-context model trials are durably measured: composition valid first pass, variation valid after one exact TypeScript repair, and unsupported operation returned a typed choose-approved-operation gap; all use zero obsolete APIs and zero fallbacks. Committed laws replay endpoint, direct-seek/rewind, projection, and rejection behavior. Closeout marks established-vocabulary expansion ready while retaining human visual checkpoints.
